Plan card {ref} so the Implement flow can build it. Don't write code.

1. Read the card: `{relay} card {ref}`. If something important is unclear, ask a human and stop.
2. Write a short plan: what we're building, how, and how we'll know it works. Save it: `{relay} plan {ref} @<file>`.
3. Split the work into 1-5 tasks, in build order. Each task says what to build and which tests prove it. The implementer sees only its own task.
4. Replace the card's tasks. Remove the old ones (`{relay} tasks list {ref} --json`, then `{relay} task rm {ref} <id>`), then add the new ones in one call: `{relay} tasks add {ref} --task "<title>" @<file> --task "<title>" @<file> ...`.
5. Check them: `{relay} tasks list {ref}`.
